title: How to make a voluntary disclosure to HMRC
text:
If you owe tax on income or gains you must tell HMRC about any unpaid tax now.

 This guide explains how to make a voluntary disclosure.
changeNote: The section ‘Ways to make a disclosure’ has been updated to explain errors you should correct and information to provide when making a disclosure, and what to do when you should have treated a worker as an employee for tax purposes.
